            elif tx < x:

            else:

            if ty > y:

        # clamp to -1..1

    # Pursuit_evasion: if there is an evader, move toward safe position

            ey = e.get("y", y)

                best_edt_dx = int((ex - x))
                best_edt_dy = int((ey - y))
        dx = max(-1, min(1, best_edt_dx))

    if mode == "territory_control":
        center_x = observation.get("center_x", width // 2)
        center_y = observation.get("center_y", height // 2)
        dx = -1 if center_x < x else (1 if center_x > x else 0)
        dy = -1 if center_y < y else (1 if center_y > y else 0)
        # ensure bounds

        ny = y + dy
        if 0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height:

        if 0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height:
            return [cand[0], cand[1]]

    return [0, 0]
